Enphase is a company that provides solar energy solutions, including microinverters, home batteries, EV chargers, and energy management software. Its core technology is the panel-level microinverter, which converts direct current (DC) from individual solar panels into alternating current (AC) power, increasing reliability and performance. The system includes the Enphase Envoy gateway for monitoring and the [Enphase Enlighten app](https://www.google.com/search?q=Enphase+Enlighten+app&num=10&newwindow=1&sca_esv=fe06bbe1a7ea018c&sxsrf=AE3TifO4lO5cOPNC1U8vEg0vXU34RqSxMw%3A1761637693677&ei=PXUAadyIKe3e0PEPjPzIsAw&ved=2ahUKEwjxlIqFtMaQAxWrLzQIHVQsBn0QgK4QegQIARAE&uact=5&oq=what+is+enphase&gs_&sclient=gws-wiz-serp&mstk=AUtExfAYJsn3UgaiJiRsWIih5_1IBdfBs4kIHd9Qaiow7RLfPHM3wYcmeeiXlI1E7gAP4gx_cqT_8WJVHs-fvHYadLh_w1YKKllthrCL_57Kt2I7N_FU8lQ7labVJBmpFxWl0tzIP-D2t-KQqbRgjCCJpNe1CHBw2AFcwl1351K7mz2Qkb_4VCxotunTqJwLMR_7fKdgB0sZVRKZMyBxdYtkdzgIo0_XMenCZd3ZOy3_7RWEaPIQmf6mtx_pX_jIXEuKNlh7ed_GP-LkcodkMMewvLDu&csui=3) for users to track energy production and consumption.

Benefits of the Enphase system
- **Increased reliability:** Because each panel has its own microinverter, the failure of one does not affect the entire system.
- **Energy management:** The system allows users to generate, store, and manage their own energy, which can lead to lower utility bills and reduced carbon footprint.
- **Power outage protection:** When paired with batteries, the system can provide backup power during a grid outage.
- **Performance optimization:** The Enlighten app provides insights into each panel's performance, helping to identify and resolve issues quickly.
